title: Chapter 1219 - 30 The Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’S Deal (Seeking Subscription)
content:
Chapter 1219 - 30 The Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’S Deal (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1219: Chapter 30 The Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s Deal (Seeking Subscription)

Very soon.

A group of Heavenly Venerates saw Lin Yuan sitting cross-legged beneath the giant core pillar.

"Galaxy."

Chi Yan Venerable immediately shouted.

"I have seen the Galaxy Venerate."

The tone of Red Lotus Venerable and other typical Peak Venerables inevitably carried respect.

There are gaps even among Heavenly Venerates, especially with the Strongest Venerable, who is the pinnacle of the Heavenly Venerate tier, a realm that most Heavenly Venerates cannot even approach.

To become the Strongest Venerable, one must first be a top-tier Peak Venerable, which automatically excludes ninety-nine percent of Heavenly Venerates.

Additionally, one must master a level thirteen legacy, not just dabble in it.

But how easy is it to master a thirteen-tier legacy? It involves thirteen-tier power and numerous threshold conditions, not to mention various risks and hidden dangers.

Encountering thirteen-tier power prematurely is both a blessing and a curse.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, looking at Chi Yan Venerable and the others with a smile: "This giant core pillar could be considered lost and regained."

Chi Yan Venerable looked at the towering giant core pillar with a smile on his face. The Fierce Sun Ancient Country now occupies and refines fifty-two core pillars.

Adding this giant core pillar, it becomes sixty-two.

Although it still does not match the Da Fu Ancient Country’s seventy-two pillars, it surpasses the Barbaric Wilderness Country, ranking second among the six ancient countries.

"With Galaxy Venerate, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s chances of winning this treasured land have greatly increased," Chi Yan Venerable said with emotional tones.

If Lin Yuan had not suddenly emerged, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country would certainly have had to ally with other ancient countries to counter Da Fu. Regardless of win or loss, intense skirmishes would have followed.

But now?

Leveraging Lin Yuan’s strength, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country has risen to the same level as Da Fu, overlooking the struggles of the other four ancient countries.

"Whether we can ultimately secure this treasured land, I’m not sure," Lin Yuan replied. At least for now, his strength cannot crush all Peak Venerables within the treasured land.

If Da Fu and the other five ancient countries joined forces, Fu Xu Venerate and many top-tier Peak Venerables could still pose a threat to Lin Yuan.

"Actually, having Galaxy Venerate here makes securing this land less important," Chi Yan Venerable said.

The emergence of a Strongest Venerable in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country? The implications are profound, at least until this Strongest Venerable surpasses the thirteenth tier, which boosts the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s confidence against any ancient country besides Da Fu.

"Still, securing it would be better," Lin Yuan said.

Succeeding in capturing this treasured land would net a large number of rare treasures produced here, along with abundant merits bestowed by the ancient countries.

Lin Yuan greatly desires the various legacies and rare treasures in the treasury of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, differing from other Heavenly Venerates who have accumulated considerable merits over the ages.

Lin Yuan is still quite young; even with formidable strength, he has not acquired much merit.

Therefore, Lin Yuan intends to seize this treasured land as best as he can, for the merits gained are substantial, and the time involved is far shorter than in a comprehensive war.

"Right, it’s definitely better to secure it."

Chi Yan Venerable grinned. Who wouldn’t want to seize the treasured land? Though the true purpose of the golden mist is unclear, it surely must be beneficial.

...

A certain location within the treasured land.

Twelve Peak Venerables from the Xuanyin Ancient Country gathered.

"In this treasure land competition, our Xuanyin Ancient Country only holds thirty-eight core pillars, ranking sixth."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate looked at the other eleven Peak Venerables of the Xuanyin Ancient Country, shook his head, and said, "And now, a Strongest Venerable like Galaxy Venerate has emerged."

The remaining eleven Peak Venerables remained silent.

Currently, the hope for Xuanyin Ancient Country to secure this treasured land is incredibly slim, almost nonexistent.

Ancient countries in the top three or even four have opportunities to contend, but sixth place? Unless Xuanyin Ancient Country hides a beast like Galaxy Venerate, there is simply no hope.

"Alas..."

Earth Yin Venerable sighed.

This treasure land contains over three hundred core pillars, truly among the most top-tier of all prime treasure lands currently.

Unfortunately, Xuanyin Ancient Country did not place enough emphasis, sending in Peak Venerables with insufficient strength, otherwise, they wouldn’t have only secured thirty-eight core pillars.

"So, I intend to trade away these thirty-eight core pillars."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate shared his thoughts.

Having ascertained that there is no hope in capturing the treasured land, they would try to minimize losses and maximize profits.

Though Xuanyin Ancient Country holds thirty-eight core pillars, ranking sixth, any of the top five ancient countries acquiring these claimed cortex pillars would rapidly ascend in rank, potentially taking first place.

"Su Yin, whom do you intend to trade with?"

Earth Yin Venerable asked, unsurprised by Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s decision.

The core pillars within the treasured land hold optimal value in such exchanges; without trading, once the competition concludes, they’d still have to withdraw, gaining nothing.

"Da Fu Ancient Country and Fierce Sun Ancient Country then."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate contemplated for a moment and then spoke.

Currently, Da Fu and Fierce Sun have the best chance of securing this treasured land, thanks to having a Strongest Venerable level presence to preside.

They desire to acquire Xuanyin’s occupied core pillars most ardently, preventing opponents from getting them even if they themselves cannot.

"Hmm."

Earth Yin Venerable nodded.

"Demand a substantial price."

Earth Yin Venerable said.

"Naturally."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate smiled.

...

In front of a core pillar of heaven.

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate silently gathered his figure and said to the many Da Fu Venerables guarding the place, "I want to see Fu Xu Venerate."

"See Fu Xu Venerate?"

Fu Yu Venerate looked at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate and started to contact Fu Xu Venerate.

After a while.

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate met Fu Xu Venerate.

"Su Yin?"

Fu Xu Venerate glanced at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate and casually said, "What do you want to see me for?"

"I intend to trade with you, Fu Xu Venerate, for the thirty-eight core pillars that my Xuanyin Ancient Country has occupied and refined." Su Yin Heavenly Venerate said with a smile.

"Trade?"

Fu Xu Venerate looked at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, "Giving up so quickly?"

"With you, Fu Xu, here, my Xuanyin Ancient Country has no hope of seizing this treasure land." Su Yin Heavenly Venerate said.

"What do you want?" Fu Xu Venerate went straight to the point.

Although the Da Fu Ancient Country still held the advantage, with the thirty-eight core pillars from the Xuanyin Ancient Country, the success would be more guaranteed.

"Fifty percent."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate looked at Fu Xu Venerate, "Once your Da Fu Ancient Country seizes this treasure land, in one trillion years, my Xuanyin Ancient Country wants fifty percent of the precious items produced from this treasure land."

"Fifty percent of the production over a trillion years?"

Fu Xu Venerate sneered, "Your Xuanyin Ancient Country has quite the appetite, wanting fifty percent just for thirty-eight core pillars?"

"It’s only fifty percent over a trillion years, not too much."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate said.

At their level, ordinary treasures hold little meaning; only the treasures produced in this newly emerged treasure land can attract attention.

The Xuanyin Ancient Country did not have the confidence to seize the treasure land itself, hence this proposal.

"Fifty percent is too much, only ten percent, and that is ten percent of the treasure production within a million years." Fu Xu Venerate said.

"That’s too little." Su Yin Heavenly Venerate immediately shook his head.

"Or you could propose other conditions." Fu Xu Venerate said, "Our Da Fu Ancient Country occupies so many treasure lands, perhaps for another treasure land, we could consider giving you fifty percent of the treasure production over a trillion years."

"Only this treasure land."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate frowned, "A trillion years cannot change, fifty percent of the treasure production can be lowered a bit, twenty percent, twenty percent is my bottom line."

"Twenty percent?"

Fu Xu Venerate looked at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, falling into thought.

Meanwhile.

A manifestation of Su Yin Heavenly Venerate.

Also descended before the giant core pillar.

"Galaxy Venerate."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate also met Lin Yuan, smiling as he spoke.

"Su Yin Heavenly Venerate." Lin Yuan looked at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate.

"I’ve come this time to make a transaction with your Fierce Sun Ancient Country."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate said, "My Xuanyin Ancient Country has refined thirty-eight core pillars in total. I wonder how much are these thirty-eight core pillars worth?"

Though his other manifestation was negotiating with Fu Xu Venerate, such a transaction would definitely go to the highest bidder, seeing which side can offer the highest price.

"What conditions?"

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan immediately said.

"Eighty percent."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate looked at Lin Yuan, "If the Fierce Sun Ancient Country captures this treasure land, eighty percent of the treasures produced within ten trillion years from this treasure land will belong to my Xuanyin Ancient Country."

"In addition, your Fierce Sun Ancient Country must gift my Xuanyin Ancient Country two first-class treasure lands."

Given that Fierce Sun Ancient Country currently ranks far behind Da Fu Ancient Country in terms of refined core pillars, Su Yin Heavenly Venerate naturally had more room to set prices.

Compared to Da Fu Ancient Country, Fierce Sun Ancient Country definitely yearns more to obtain the thirty-eight core pillars of Xuanyin Ancient Country.

"Too much."

Lin Yuan frowned at Su Yin Heavenly Venerate.

Not to mention the two first-class treasure lands.

Eighty percent of the treasures produced in ten trillion years?

Isn’t that saying that within ten trillion years, Lin Yuan won’t gain much of the treasures produced by this treasure land?

Perhaps for Fierce Sun Ancient Country, this condition is acceptable, after all, ten trillion years isn’t unreasonably long, but for Lin Yuan?

How long has it been since embarking on the path of evolution until now? Ten trillion years? In such a long time, even if Lin Yuan doesn’t step into the thirteenth tier, he would be trapped in a time cycle, and by then, even more treasures of the land would mean nothing to him.

"Not too much."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate smiled at Lin Yuan, "The Da Fu Ancient Country has already agreed to my conditions."

"Galaxy Venerate, you should know, once my Xuanyin Ancient Country’s thirty-eight core pillars fall into Da Fu Ancient Country’s hands, your Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s hope of capturing this treasure land will be significantly reduced."

"With the relationship between the Thunderclap Ancient Country and Da Fu Ancient Country, ultimately the core pillars of the Thunderclap Ancient Country will certainly fall into Da Fu Ancient Country’s hands as well."

"You have to think it through."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate looked at Lin Yuan with an expression of ’I am considering for you.’

"Are you threatening me?" Lin Yuan squinted his eyes slightly.

"There is no threat, everything is purely voluntary." Su Yin Heavenly Venerate’s face displayed a smile.
